data.value: Will at least 200 of the 5,000 newsletter subscribers Tidepool emails on launch morning click through to join the beta waitlist within 72 hours?

Tidepool has a newsletter with 5000 subscribers. On launch morning (2026-09-22T08:00:00-07:00), Tidepool sends an email to all subscribers promoting a beta waitlist. The email includes a personal note from the founder and the waitlist link is above the fold. The typical click-through rate for the newsletter is 6%.
